command:
kubectl patch multiclusterservice baseline-services --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/serviceSpec/services/0/values","value":"kyverno:

    replicas: 2
"}]'
kubectl --kubeconfig=/tmp/managed-cluster-01.kubeconfig delete pod test-pod

stdout:

pod "test-pod" deleted from default namespace
clusterpolicy.kyverno.io "require-labels" deleted
